instructions: Shepherd has no rerun to offer and no log excerpt to show for the checks under `## Failing checks`, so it cannot tell from GitHub's data why they failed or what would fix them. Find out before acting. Start with `gh run view 200 -R owner/repo`: it lists the run's jobs and annotations. Playbook: "Check follow-up".

If the cause is within this PR, fix it and push. Otherwise make no change and keep what you found; do not rerun or retrigger these checks. If these checks are unchanged on the next poll, Shepherd escalates with `check-follow-up-unavailable`; report that diagnosis then.

Triage the merge-queue ejection before any requeue. If the `**queue removal**` reason shows GitHub removed the entry itself, update the PR head from the latest base first. If a person may have dequeued the PR, skip that update unless a conflict step above requires it. Shepherd printed no queue command for this session, so do not enqueue the PR. Playbook: "Merge queue ejection".
If the base update or a fix changed the head, commit any remaining changes and push to the PR head branch. If neither did, do not push.
